name: exp-gain-u64
summary: EXP gains are 64-bit end to end: sp_GainExp can add a u64 (high dword from a slot the quest_exp plugin fills) and NC_BAT_EXPGAIN (0x240B) carries {u32 low, u16 handle, u32 high}.
status: WRITTEN 2026-09-25 (ticket Q32; pairs with client recipe client-2026-exp-gain-u64).
why: ShinePlayer::sp_GainExp(int exp in edi, u16 handle [ebp+0xC], ...) 0x42D830, after the freeze (0x42D944: edi = 0)
and the level-cap exit (0x42D955):
0042D967  66 8B 5D 0C        mov  bx, [ebp+0xC]          ; handle
0042D96B  8B C7              mov  eax, edi
0042D96E  01 86 57 7F 00 00  add  [esi+0x7F57], eax       ; u64 player EXP += sign-extended int
0042D974  6A 08              push 8                       ; packet length
0042D97B  11 96 5B 7F 00 00  adc  [esi+0x7F5B], edx
0042D98B  66 89 10           mov  [eax], dx
0042D98E  89 78 02           mov  [eax+2], edi             ; u32 exp
0042D991  66 89 58 06        mov  [eax+6], bx              ; u16 handle
0042D995  E8 ..              call pp_SetPacketLen, then the send
The EXP is already u64 in the player (+0x7F57) and in the level check that follows (0x42DA49); only the int
argument and the 6-byte packet are 32-bit. The cave keeps the sign-extended amount for every stock caller and
takes the HIGH dword from this region's slot when the slot names this player: the quest_exp plugin writes
{player, high} at +0 and calls sp_GainExp(low) once for a quest reward of any size. The cave clears the slot
itself and ignores the high dword while the player's EXP is frozen (+0x2A5CC == 1, where edi was zeroed).
The packet is always {0x240B, u32 low, u16 handle, u32 high} (12 bytes with the opcode); the 2026 client reads
the high dword with client-2026-exp-gain-u64. One level at most per call is the zone's own rule (no loop at
0x42DA49): the overshoot stays in the total and levels on the next gain, as on official.
Region layout: +0 player u32, +4 high u32, +0x10 the cave.

new_section.name: .expgain64
new_section.note: Labelled .expgain64 in the arena directory: the quest_exp plugin finds the slot at +0 by that label.
